title: ActivationEnvelope
description: Content-free evidence a client posts to the activation adjudicate endpoint each campaign turn. Carries optimization-run results and structured abstractions ONLY: configuration labels, per-example score vectors keyed by opaque rotating IDs, aggregate metrics, cost. Raw prompts, inputs, outputs, expected outputs, dataset rows, schema/query text, source code, and execution traces are OUT OF CONTRACT and MUST NOT appear in any field, including free-form maps.

envelope_version.description: Privacy/abstraction contract version the client compiled this payload against (e.g. 'activation/v1').

phase.description: Phase the client believes it is in; the server adjudicates and may advance it.

directive_id.description: Id of the server directive this evidence answers, if any (idempotency / lease binding).

eval_manifest.description: Eval-function descriptor for the eval-health analyzer. Counts and numeric quality only; no example content.

repeated_run_count.description: How many times identical configs were re-scored (for scorer-variance estimation).

unscoreable_count.description: Examples the scorer could not score (errors/timeouts).

search_space_summary.description: The configuration space as labels and class summaries — never raw prompt/code values.

cardinality.description: Number of distinct candidates for categorical/text knobs.

domain_summary.description: Coarse class label only (e.g. 'model_tier', 'prompt_variant'); MUST NOT be a raw value.

composite_measures_present.description: Names of composite_* measures emitted by composite knobs (route/escalation/vote counts), not their values.

trial_summaries.description: One row per trial: config identified by hash + TVAR value LABELS, with numeric scores and cost.

config_hash.description: Stable hash of the config vector.

tvar_value_labels.description: TVAR name -> opaque value label (e.g. 'schema_context' -> 'on'); never raw prompt/code text.

trial_count.description: Examples evaluated in this trial (for significance).

per_example_vectors.description: Per (example, config) outcome keyed by an opaque, per-campaign rotating example id. Booleans/numbers/enums only — no example content.

example_id.description: Rotating HMAC id, salted per campaign so it cannot be linked across campaigns.

error_enum.description: Controlled failure taxonomy code (e.g. 'execution_error', 'empty_result', 'syntax_error'); NOT a raw error message.

client_proposals.description: Optional content-free next-move candidates the client agent surfaced from its private reflection (the A3 fallback). Action classes + reason codes only.

evidence_refs.description: References to observation/cluster ids, not content.
